home.meta_description: A teacher’s Telegram channel plus group and one-to-one lessons: clear explanations, real practice and a step-by-step path from A1 to C1.
home.hero_h1: Learn a foreign language — without the boredom
home.hero_subtitle: A Telegram channel run by a teacher: clear explanations, real practice and useful materials that help you start speaking.
home.about_card1_p: Join the Telegram channel and the materials and examples are available right away. Short posts and visual explanations make every topic easy to follow.
home.about_card2_p: Structured tips, detailed breakdowns and materials you can put into practice straight away.
home.about_card3_p: Learning materials, language breakdowns, practice, handy collections and a bit of humor — more reasons to stay in touch with the language.
home.levels_p: The program follows the international CEFR scale: you start from your current level and move up one step at a time.
home.levels_note: How fast you progress depends on your goals and regular practice.
home.level_a1_p: You understand and use everyday phrases: you can introduce yourself, ask simple questions and answer them.
home.level_a2_p: You talk about yourself, your work, shopping and your day in short, simple sentences.
home.level_b1_p: You cope with most everyday and travel situations, describe your experience and explain your plans.
home.level_b2_p: You speak confidently on a wide range of topics, follow complex texts and argue your point of view.
home.level_c1_p: You express yourself fluently and precisely and use the language for study and work.
home.program_left_li3: Light practice: dialogues, mini-tasks and memes
home.program_right_li2: Teacher support and answers to your questions
home.pricing_p: The invoice is in hryvnias at the NBU rate of the day it is issued. You pay by card transfer using the invoice in the Academy bot (see Contacts) and then press “I have paid”; the teacher confirms the payment.
home.program_main_p: Lessons, practice and support are all in the channel. Join today — access is open.
home.reviews_card1_p: Before class, I open the channel and review the topic. Examples with mistakes are especially helpful — I recognize my own in them.
home.reviews_card2_p: I’m learning English for work. I already use some phrases from the lessons in my messages. They stick much better this way than when you just write them down in your notes.
home.reviews_card3_p: Before the trip, I just wanted to be able to get by in a shop, café, or hotel. I liked that there are plenty of these everyday situations here without a ton of theory.
home.reviews_card4_p: I came back to English after quite a long break. I thought it would be harder, but little by little things are coming back. I especially like that you can ask again if you’re unsure about something, and nobody makes a big deal out of it.
home.reviews_card5_p: I need a rule shown with an example, not explained with half a page of terms. That's fine here.
home.reviews_card6_p: In the group, someone is always asking something or making a mistake somewhere. Sometimes I hear someone else’s question and realize I was doing the same thing. I like that, because you learn not only from your own mistakes.

rules.rules_intro: How lessons, payment and refunds work, in brief. You book and pay in the Academy’s Telegram bot; the app there always has the current version of the rules.
rules.rules_1_p: Lessons are online, in small groups by language and level, and last 60 minutes. A group has 3 to 10 seats. A lesson takes place when it has 3 confirmed participants and at least one of them has paid with money. Lessons start strictly on schedule.
rules.rules_2_li3: The invoice is in hryvnias at the official NBU rate of the day it is issued, rounded to a whole hryvnia. The amount does not change afterwards.
rules.rules_3_p: The first two seats in a group are booked for free. The third booking starts payment: all three get an invoice and have up to 12 hours to pay, but no later than 6 hours before the start. Everyone after them gets an invoice at once. You can book until an hour before the start if a seat is free; with a late booking the transfer and its check must be finished by then.
rules.rules_4_p: You pay by card transfer using the invoice in the app. Put the order number in the transfer comment and press “I have paid” after the transfer. The lesson’s teacher confirms the payment once the money has arrived; while it is being checked, your seat is kept. The sender pays the bank’s commission. If less arrives, the rest has to be paid; an overpayment or a second transfer for the same invoice is returned. Never write a card number in messages.
rules.rules_5_p: 6 hours before the start we check the group: if it has 3 participants together with the payments still being checked, it waits for the final decision; otherwise the lesson is called off. The final decision is made an hour before the start: 3 confirmed participants are needed, at least one of them paid with money.
rules.rules_6_li1: A paid booking can be cancelled for free until 6 hours before the start — once per calendar month. Later it can be cancelled without a refund.
rules.rules_6_li2: A paid seat can be moved to another lesson of the same language and level until 6 hours before the start — twice per calendar month.
rules.rules_6_li3: If the Academy calls a lesson off or the group does not form, you choose a refund or another lesson; you have 7 calendar days to choose.
rules.rules_6_li4: If you miss a lesson, there is no refund, but you keep the lesson materials if the teacher attached them.
rules.rules_7_p: Refunds are made by hand, by transfer, within 5 business days of the moment the refund became due; the date is shown in your booking. Where possible, the money goes back to whoever sent it. If your details are needed, the teacher asks for them in person, outside the app; while the Academy waits for them, the term is paused.
rules.rules_8_p: Coins are the Academy’s bonus points, not money. They can pay for part of a lesson or all of it: 500 coins give 25% off, 1000 — 50%, 1500 — 75%, 2000 — 100%. The rest is paid by transfer. Coins come back when you cancel in time or the Academy cancels.
rules.rules_9_p: An interview with a teacher (30 minutes, 5 USD) determines your level. Book it no later than 2 hours before the start and pay within 6 hours of booking, but no later than an hour before the start. Cancelling at least 6 hours before gives a full refund or another time; later, or if you do not come, there is no refund.
rules.rules_10_p: Lessons take place in a video room of the JaaS service (8x8). Your personal link is in the app: you can join 5 minutes before the start, and until the teacher comes in you wait in a waiting room. Lessons are not recorded. Only your first name is passed to 8x8.
rules.rules_11_p: A teacher records a violation only after a check: a knowingly false “I have paid”, or 3 invoices within 30 calendar days that ran out with neither a payment nor “I have paid”. Before a decision you have 24 hours to explain. The first violation is a warning, the next ones are strikes; 2 strikes within 90 calendar days lower your limits of free bookings and unpaid invoices to one. The restriction ends after 3 attended lessons paid with money.

privacy.privacy_intro: This policy describes what data the Polyglot Academy website, Telegram bot and app process, and why.
privacy.privacy_1_li1: The website: only one technical cookie with the language you chose.
privacy.privacy_1_li2: The bot and the app: your Telegram data (ID, first and last name, @username, language) and your settings (languages, levels, time zone).
privacy.privacy_1_li3: Learning: bookings of lessons and interviews, attendance, test and sparring results, coins.
privacy.privacy_1_li4: Payment: invoice amounts and numbers, what you wrote in “I have paid” (payer’s name, date of the transfer), records of the money received and refunded. We do not keep card numbers.
privacy.privacy_1_li5: Your messages to the Academy: problem reports and explanations.
privacy.privacy_2_p: We use your data only to:
privacy.privacy_2_li3: answer your requests and improve the service
privacy.privacy_3_p: Telegram — the bot and the app work through it. The JaaS video service (8x8) — only your first name and an internal number, to let you into the video room; lessons are not recorded. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.privacy_4_p: Analytics events — one year, active days — three years. The bot’s messages about a lesson are deleted from the chat after it. Financial records are kept as long as the law requires. Database backups are kept for up to one year.
privacy.privacy_5_p: The website uses one technical cookie to remember the language you chose. We do not use cookies for advertising or tracking.
privacy.privacy_6_p: You can ask us to show, correct or delete your data — write to us (contacts below). Financial records the Academy must keep by law are deleted when that term ends.

terms.terms_2_p: Learning results depend on your own effort. The project does not guarantee that you will reach a specific language level.

terms.terms_5_html: Prices, payment, cancelling, moving and refunds follow the Academy rules. A group lesson costs 10 USD, a level interview 5 USD; the invoice is in hryvnias at the NBU rate.
